## 2. Columns and types (train / live)

- `bank_transactions`: bank_txn_id:VARCHAR, account_id:VARCHAR, entity:VARCHAR, bank:VARCHAR, statement_format:VARCHAR, statement_file:VARCHAR, booking_date:DATE, value_date:DATE, amount:DOUBLE, currency:VARCHAR, bank_code:VARCHAR, bank_subcode:VARCHAR, ref1:VARCHAR, ref2:VARCHAR, text:VARCHAR, counterparty_name:VARCHAR, counterparty_account:VARCHAR, end_to_end_id:VARCHAR, remittance_info:VARCHAR, orig_amount:DOUBLE, orig_currency:VARCHAR
- `ar_invoices`: item_id:VARCHAR, entity:VARCHAR, document_number:VARCHAR, issue_date:DATE, due_date:DATE, customer_id:VARCHAR, customer_name:VARCHAR, currency:VARCHAR, net_amount:DOUBLE, tax_amount:DOUBLE, total_amount:DOUBLE, payment_terms:VARCHAR, customer_po:VARCHAR, payment_method:VARCHAR
- `ap_invoices`: item_id:VARCHAR, entity:VARCHAR, supplier_id:VARCHAR, supplier_name:VARCHAR, supplier_invoice_number:VARCHAR, issue_date:DATE, due_date:DATE, currency:VARCHAR, net_amount:DOUBLE, tax_amount:DOUBLE, total_amount:DOUBLE, payment_terms:VARCHAR, our_po:BIGINT, payment_method:VARCHAR
- `credit_notes`: item_id:VARCHAR, side:VARCHAR, entity:VARCHAR, document_number:VARCHAR, issue_date:DATE, party_id:VARCHAR, party_name:VARCHAR, currency:VARCHAR, net_amount:DOUBLE, tax_amount:DOUBLE, total_amount:DOUBLE, related_document:VARCHAR, reason:VARCHAR
- `golden_allocations`: bank_txn_id:VARCHAR, item_id:VARCHAR, amount:DOUBLE, category:VARCHAR, exception:VARCHAR, segment:VARCHAR, difficulty:BIGINT
- `open_items_at_start` (live): item_id:VARCHAR, item_type:VARCHAR, entity:VARCHAR, party_id:VARCHAR, document_number:VARCHAR, issue_date:DATE, due_date:DATE, currency:VARCHAR, total_amount:DOUBLE, open_amount:DOUBLE
